description: Door watcher for Rokid glasses for people working in an inner room or wearing headphones: register the front door once by facing it from your usual seat (the direction the agent reports always comes from that registration, never from the sound), then an omnidirectional microphone level watch reacts only to loud-sound PATTERNS - a burst of short loud spikes (knock-shaped) or one bell-length loud tone - and nudges you once per episode with the door's direction relative to you. The platform has no sound classification and no sound localization, so the agent never claims to hear a doorbell or a knock; the watch runs only while this page is open and nothing is stored.
name: door-watch
